begin_of_turn_query.content: 計劃在2024年12月24日從紐約市前往東京的精彩旅程，搭乘頭等艙！我已經準備好我的信用卡，卡號為 id card_5678，快要到期了，我想明智地分配商務開支。持卡人的名字與我相符，為邁克爾·湯普森（Michael Thompson），需要時我可以提供 CVV，為 456。請幫我確認一下航班的費用，然後能否使用訪問令牌 'abc123xyz' 進行預訂？

They want to check flight cost from NYC to Tokyo on Dec 24, 2024, first class. Then they want to book using access token abc123xyz. We need to call get_flight_cost with travel_from: "New York" (NYC), travel_to: "Tokyo", travel_date: "2024-12-24", travel_class: "first". Then we need to call purchase_insurance? Actually they want to book flight. There's no direct booking function. There's purchase_insurance but not booking flight. There's get_flight_cost. There's no function to book flight. So we can only get flight cost. Then we can ask them to provide access token. But they already gave access token abc123xyz. We can call get_flight_cost. Then we can respond with cost. Then we can ask if they'd like to proceed. But we cannot actually book. So we can just provide cost.
